info.title: Ablaki owned financial hierarchy report
info.description: Backend/API only. Code prepared, no tests or deployment. No new migration; branch still requires schema marker 21. Current connected owned financial nodes, not the physical subtree or all users of a world.

get.summary: Consolidate current visible owned financial branch without double-counting internal transfers
get.description: world_read and actual root ownership required. Follow economy_parent_rule/history current links (matching history/subject/revision, effective_to null), never world_node.parent_id. Apply ownership and WorldAccessPolicy before limits and traversal; stop at foreign/hidden/archived nodes and never jump over them. Only node subjects with Cr budget/treasury are included; loss sinks, assets/NPC accounts and personal wallets excluded. Internal transfers contribute zero net boundary flow. Lifetime historical transfers are classified using current membership; this is not an as-of historical consolidation. REPEATABLE READ snapshot for membership, balances, ledger, counts and members. No writes, provisioning, collection, catch-up jobs or hierarchy repair.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trimmed substring search of selected member names; filters member list/count only, not boundary, balances or financial totals. Fixed descending node ID order.

200.description: Consistent read-only snapshot of the entire selected branch; list is paginated. Missing accounts are not created.

403.description: Requested root must be actually owned; world-manage is not an override

404.description: Root missing or hidden by world access rules

422.description: Invalid filters or FINANCE_SCOPE_TOO_LARGE (more than 200 selected nodes or 32 levels); no partial financial totals

503.description: World read/schema unavailable, visible owned cycle/cross-world financial link, or invalid account balances/reserves

totals.description: All-time transfers relative to CURRENT selected accounts. external_in/out exclude internal transfers. internal_transfers is counted once and partitioned into collections, parent payments and other. external_losses and external_parent_payments are subsets of external_out; personal investments are a subset of external_in. ledger_balance = external_in - external_out. A payment across the selected boundary does not mean newly minted Cr or world revenue.

reconciled.description: Every selected account matches its ledger, not just combined balances. Does not prove reservation/receipt reconciliation or correctness of the entire world.

Member.description: Only a visible node actually owned by the caller. parent_node_id refers to an included financial parent and may not be on this page; null for requested root. No hidden branch IDs/counts.
